{{Quote|My squad went into munitions plant and tried putting out the fire. We failed. I barely made it out. The others... they're gone.|Kallum|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kallum''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR dates|4}} The [[Battle of Corellia]] takes place during Act III, so it can therefore be placed in 3641 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Kallum and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] attempted to put out the fires and remove the [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] charges from [[Starship/Legends|starship]] torpedoes in the [[Labor Valley]]. Attacked by enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the squad members were all [[Death/Legends|killed]], with Kallum the only survivor. He made it back to the nearest medical station and asked a Republic-allied individual to finish the job.
